title: Apna Sapna Money Money
desc: Arjun and Shivani are in love, but Shivani's father will never let them marry each other. Later chaos ensues when Arjun enlists the help of his conman cousin, Kishan, to unite him with Shivani.

title: Tabahi Zulm Ki
desc: While doing his mission to eradicate corruption, an undercover journalist experiences a forbidden relationship when he falls in love with a high-profile gangster's daughter.

title: Vikramadithyan
desc: Two close friends face various hurdles as they navigate the complexities of life while striving to realise their shared dreams.

title: Great Grand Masti
desc: Three friends travel to a small town where they meet Ragini, a gorgeous woman. However, their life changes as Ragini brings nothing but trouble to them.
